title: Commission Tier/Flat — a saved reset day is not stored
requirementSource: NM-3633 / NM-2168: choosing a reset day and clicking Save in the Reset Date modal must succeed and persist the day
stepsToReproduce: Open Setup → Commissions → Tier/Flat for office 1101 (/navigator/locations/1101/commissions/tiers) on e2e and click Search.
Click Reset Dates; choose 1 for January (the only non-blank choice — see BUG-COM-TF-007) and click Save.
Click Cancel, then Reset Dates again; open the Commission Tier/Flat Reset Date History tab.
expectedBehavior: January shows 1 after reopening, and Reset Date History lists the change.
actualBehavior: Save shows no error and the modal stays open, but after reopening January is blank again and Reset Date History reads "0 items found" — nothing is stored.

verificationLog.finding: Failed on both attempts of the full run with writes and on an isolated rerun; the modal's Reset Date History stays empty after two saves.
